ideas.pitch: An automated Qiskit circuit optimization script that leverages local heuristics to aggressively reduce CNOT gate count and circuit depth for hardware execution.
ideas.problem_statement: Improve the efficiency of quantum circuits by reducing unnecessary gates, lowering circuit depth, and preserving computational behavior using Qiskit.
ideas.title: QDepth-Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core performance metric of the competition by demonstrating measurable reductions in gate depth and resource usage, aligning with the evaluation criteria for technical correctness and optimization degree.

ideas.pitch: A Python utility that parses quantum circuits in Qiskit, identifies redundant multi-qubit gate sequences, and applies algebraic cancellation rules to optimize hardware compatibility.
ideas.problem_statement: Improve the efficiency of quantum circuits by simplifying equivalent operations and considering practical hardware constraints.
ideas.title: QGate-Simplifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features genuinely hard engineering in quantum logic reduction and showcases a robust algorithm that works reliably under strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: A Qiskit-based optimizer that reorganizes circuit topology to fit restricted physical qubit connectivity maps while minimizing SWAP gate overhead.
ideas.problem_statement: Improve the efficiency of quantum circuits while considering practical hardware constraints, qubit operations, and resource usage.
ideas.title: Hardware-Aware Qubit Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world NISQ hardware limitations, giving judges a clear engineering justification for how the optimization translates to physical hardware execution.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Qiskit pipeline that profiles input circuits, benchmarks initial execution metrics, and applies template-based matching to compress gate counts instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will receive one or more quantum circuits and will be asked to optimize them while preserving the required computational behaviour or output.
ideas.title: Circuit-Diet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a live, working demo that takes an unoptimized circuit as input and outputs a verified optimized circuit with a clear performance report.

ideas.pitch: An advanced Qiskit optimization pass that utilizes commutation relations between gates to slide and cancel adjacent operations, achieving lower overall depth.
ideas.problem_statement: The challenge may involve reducing unnecessary gates, lowering circuit depth, improving gate usage, and simplifying equivalent operations.
ideas.title: Commutation-Pass Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep technical reasoning and strong mastery of quantum circuit mechanics, directly hitting the judges' criteria for technical rigor.
